agency.conversation.title: Case conversation
agency.conversation.scaffold: Prototype: replies are deterministic, not generated by a live AI agent. Sending a message or clarification does not approve a document or authorize changes.
agency.conversation.loadError: Could not refresh the conversation. Please try again.
agency.conversation.materialReferenced: This message references the material attached to this case.
agency.conversation.processing: Message saved. Its response is not available yet; refresh to check.
agency.conversation.replyReceived: Clarification received. Its waiting workflow resumed; this is not document approval or a new agent decision.
agency.conversation.invalid: Enter a message of up to 20,000 characters.
agency.conversation.saveError: We could not confirm receipt. Retry to send the same message safely.
agency.conversation.waitEnded: This clarification is no longer waiting for a reply. Refresh the conversation to see its latest state.
agency.conversation.retryHint: Your original text is kept unchanged for this retry, so an uncertain response cannot create a duplicate message.
agency.cases.title: My cases
agency.cases.loadError: Your cases could not be loaded. Try refreshing the list.
agency.materials.loadError: The material was submitted, but its current status could not be loaded. Try refreshing the status.
agency.materials.notFound: This case is not available to your account.
agency.materials.status.UNAVAILABLE: The material was received. Processing status is not available yet.
agency.materials.status.COMPENSATING: Processing is being rolled back. The result is not ready.
agency.materials.status.COMPENSATED: Processing was rolled back. Your agency can review the case.
agency.materials.status.FORKED: Processing has branched into additional work. The result is not ready yet.
agency.demo.title: Test tasks
agency.demo.description: Try document previews, approvals and comments.
agency.demo.notice: Six independent examples based on the FLOW templates. Decisions stay on this screen and disappear on refresh. They do not change an order or publish anything.
agency.demo.localResult: This result is local — nothing was sent.
agency.review.description: Review the document, then accept this version or send us your comments.
agency.review.versionHint: You are accepting version {version} only. To request a change, choose Add comments. A new version will need a new approval.
agency.review.pairHint: Strategy and Tone of Voice are separate documents. Content planning starts after both current versions have been accepted.
agency.review.publicationHint: This is a separate consent to publish the post below at the specified destination. Content approval does not grant publication consent.
agency.review.topicLabel: Choose one topic for your post
agency.review.topicPlaceholder: Choose a topic from the plan
agency.review.topicHint: Your approval covers the 12-topic plan and one selected topic for production.
agency.review.commentsEmpty: Select a fragment of the document to add a comment.
agency.review.commentsPlaceholder: Tell us what to change. You can refer to a specific section of the document.
agency.review.commentsDescription: Comments on {title}, version {version}. We will review them and prepare a reply or a revised version.
agency.review.accepted: Your decision has been sent and is awaiting processing.
agency.review.commentsSent: Your comments have been sent. We will notify you when a reply or a new version is ready.
agency.review.stale: This version needs review or has been replaced. Please wait for the current document.
agency.review.readOnly: This document is available for viewing. No decision is required from you right now.
agency.review.submitError: We could not confirm receipt of your request. Your comments remain in the dialog. Please try again.
agency.review.invalid: This document is not ready for review. Its content or version details are missing.
agency.materials.title: Materials
agency.materials.description: Send material to your agency. This does not create an order or confirm payment.
agency.materials.success: Material received and processed. Your agency can now view the case.
agency.materials.invalid: Enter a title and choose a non-empty material file.
agency.materials.unlinked: Your account must be linked to a customer before submitting material.
agency.materials.analysisHint: Upload analysis JSON (up to 1 MiB) containing order and optional pages/socialPosts source inputs. The product selection must match the agency's configured process. Other file formats are not supported.
agency.materials.processHint: Research invokes the configured server-side agents. Storage alone does not call an AI model.
agency.materials.corpusHint: For research, upload a normalized ToV corpus: a JSON array of 1–100 posts, up to 1 MiB. Other document formats are not yet supported for research.
agency.materials.invalidProcess: Choose a supported process, enter its brand and select English or Polish.
agency.materials.status.COMPLETED: Material received. The requested process is complete and your agency can view the case.
agency.materials.status.RUNNING: Material received. Processing has started; the result is not ready yet.
agency.materials.status.WAITING_FOR_ACTI: Material received and accepted for background processing. The result is not ready yet.
agency.materials.status.PAUSED: Material received. Processing is paused; your agency can review the case.
agency.materials.status.FAILED: Material received, but processing failed. Your agency can review the case.
agency.materials.status.CANCELLED: Material received, but processing was cancelled. Your agency can review the case.
agency.review.clarificationOnly: Add the missing information in comments. Acceptance is available only after the brief passes review.
